provenance.notes: Every value is illustrative: Kessling County, Michigan, its towns (Ardmore Falls, Halvorsen, Corwin), addresses, ZIP codes, square footages, schedules, the solicitation (RFP No. 2026-041), the incumbent (Northern Shores Building Services, Inc., Contract No. KC-23-0412, $91,240/month) and the purchasing contact (reserved .example.org domain). No rows were copied. The structure and wording follow the county and city janitorial RFPs cited: Grand Traverse County building blocks ("estimated square footage:" / "Evenings: Monday thru Friday"), Clinton County "Scope of Work: ... (approximately N sq. ft.)" lead and "five (5) nights per week", Franklin County floor-by-floor areas, Burlington "Approx. Area Cleaned", Black Hawk County jail administration area only, St. Croix per-building pricing, Lenoir / Winnebago / Ventura / Missouri addenda. Research limits: WebFetch failed to resolve every host and the egress proxy refused direct downloads, so the sources were read only through search-engine excerpts; the quoted phrases are as the excerpts gave them. The sally-port / inmate-worker exclusion wording was not found verbatim in any source and is the author's construction from the jail-administration-only scopes (Black Hawk, Lenoir) and the Clinton County holding-cell mention. Independent review (2026-10-23): WebFetch again failed DNS and the proxy refused direct download (403); search excerpts confirmed the Black Hawk County 2024 janitorial bid scope "Jail (Administration Area and Consolidated Communications Center)" and the Winnebago County 24P-2358 Addendum Two Q&A on the incumbent and annual contract value (answered there by attaching the prior agreement and an invoice); the Grand Traverse and Clinton County phrases could not be re-confirmed from excerpts. All truth values were re-derived from the rendered DOCX and agree.

traps: Narrative inventory: square footage, floors, days of service and exclusions for each site are in prose under "SECTION 3 - DESCRIPTION OF FACILITIES / LOCATIONS". Table 3-1 is a short summary (Site | Facility | Address | Approx. Sq. Ft. | Service Days) of the 17 County buildings only: it has no floors, hours or cleaning areas, and it omits the four park facilities (Sites 18-21), which exist only as run-in paragraphs in Section 3.4.

Three narrative layouts in one document: Sites 1-9 are Heading 4 + address line + paragraph (Site 2 instead has a plain Grand Traverse-style block under its heading: "Kessling County Administration Building - estimated square footage: 52,400" / "400 E. Main Street - Evenings: Monday thru Friday"); Sites 10-17 (and Addendum Site 22) are Grand Traverse-style three-line blocks with only the site name bold and the lines split by <w:br/> ("Site 10 - Central Garage (Facilities & Fleet) - estimated square footage: 34,200" / "2850 County Farm Road - Evenings: Monday thru Friday" / "Ardmore Falls, MI 49689") followed by a prose paragraph; Sites 18-21 are single paragraphs with a bold name lead and the address in the same paragraph (a separate plain run). A reader that drops <w:br/> glues the area to the street number ("34,2002850 County Farm Road", "5,280 sq. ft.610 Orchard Street").

Mixed area wording: "Scope of Work: Kessling County Courthouse (approximately 38,900 sq. ft.)", "estimated square footage: 52,400", "9,860 sq. ft. +/-", "approximately 41,750 square feet", "approximately 5,280 sq. ft.". Street numbers (1700, 1720, 2850, 7700) and ZIP codes (49689, 49631, 49655) sit next to the areas.

Floor-by-floor and floor-finish breakdowns are not facilities: Administration Building 9,800 + 14,200 x 3 = 52,400 and carpet 34,000 + VCT 11,600 + ceramic 6,800 = 52,400; Justice Center 26,150 + 24,300 + 20,800 = 71,250; Human Services 21,420 + 20,330 = 41,750, revised by the addendum to 25,880 + 20,330 = 46,210.

Gross vs contractor cleaning area (stated in the narrative only; Table 3-1 shows the gross with an asterisk glued to the number, "71,250*", "96,800*", "34,200*"): Justice Center 71,250 gross, holding cells / prisoner corridor / sally port 2,100 excluded, cleaning area 69,150; Jail 96,800 gross, secure areas (housing, booking, vehicle sally port, kitchen, laundry, medical) cleaned by inmate workers, contractor area 5,850; Central Garage 34,200 gross, 29,850 of bays excluded, contractor area 4,350. Truth: grossSqft = building area, cleanableSqft = the stated contractor area.

Exclusions with no stated area (Courthouse basement archive room, Administration server room, Health Department lab and pharmacy, Senior Center kitchen, Animal Control kennels / surgery, LEC evidence room, Records shelving) do not change the stated building area; cleanableSqft is not set for those sites.

Section 3.5 "Facilities Not Included" lists buildings with areas that are NOT in scope: Juvenile Detention Center (18,600), Medical Care Facility (84,000), former Corwin Township Hall (3,100, vacant / for sale), Pine Run Park restroom (450, removed from service, demolition spring 2027), Airport terminal (no area). Also not in scope: the Lakeview concession stand (separate 420 sq. ft. building) and the fairgrounds barns, grandstand and outdoor restrooms.

Addendum No. 1 (dated November 20, 2026, bound after Attachment B) supersedes the RFP and the original pages never hint at it: Item 2 revises Site 4 Human Services Building from 41,750 to 46,210 sq. ft. (4,460 sq. ft. WIC addition); Item 3 adds Site 22 Community Corrections and Pretrial Services Office (5,280 sq. ft., one story, Monday / Wednesday / Friday evenings); Item 4 revises the Table 3-1 total to 489,830 for 18 buildings.
Stale prose total: Section 1.2 still says "seventeen (17) County buildings totaling approximately 480,000 square feet" after the addendum; it is a rounded prose total, not a facility.

Totals are not facilities: Table 3-1 "TOTAL - 17 County buildings" 480,090; Addendum Item 4 "TOTAL - 18 County buildings: 489,830"; Attachment B "TOTAL ANNUAL PRICE (Lines A-1 through C-3)". Table 3-1 total = sum of its rows; with the addendum, 480,090 + 4,460 + 5,280 = 489,830. Parks (1,840 + 1,120 + 380 + 3,600 = 6,940) are outside both totals; all 22 in-scope facilities sum to 496,770.

Attachment B repeats the sites with its own line numbers that differ from site numbers: A-17 is Site 20, B-1/B-2 are Sites 18/19, C-1 is Site 17, C-2 is Site 21, C-3/C-4 are "All", and the addendum adds A-18 for Site 22. "Est. Qty / Yr" values (12, 1, 31, 58, 40) are pricing quantities, not facility data. Building numbers in truth are the Site numbers.

Names differ between the narrative, Table 3-1 and Attachment B: "Kessling County Administration Building" / "Administration Building"; "Commission on Aging Senior Center" / "Senior Center"; "Law Enforcement Center (Sheriff's Office and Central Dispatch)" / "Law Enforcement Center / Central Dispatch"; "Kessling County Jail" / "Jail (public and administrative areas only)" / "Jail - public and admin areas"; "Lakeview County Park, Beach House" / "Lakeview Beach House". Same facilities, not extras.

Service frequency wording (per site): "five (5) nights per week, Monday thru Friday" and "Evenings: Monday thru Friday" = daily_5; "six (6) days per week, Monday thru Saturday ... No Sunday cleaning" while the library is open Sundays Sept-May = daily_6; "seven (7) days per week, including holidays" (LEC) = daily_7; "three (3) evenings per week - Monday, Wednesday and Friday" and "Friday, Saturday and Sunday mornings" = 3x_week; "Tuesday and Friday", "Tuesday and Thursday", "Monday and Thursday" evenings = 2x_week; "Once per week (Thursday)" plus on-call after EOC activations = weekly; "Every other Wednesday (26 visits per year)" = biweekly. Table 3-1 abbreviations: "M-F", "M, W, F", "M-Sat", "7 days", "Tu, F", "Th", "Alt. Wed.", "Tu, Th", "M, Th", "On call".

No recurring service level for event / rental sites: Fairgrounds Exhibit Hall (Site 17) is cleaned after scheduled events (31 in 2025) and each morning of fair week; Cedar Bluff Lodge (Site 21) after each rental (58 in 2025). serviceLevel is omitted for both.

Seasonal park buildings: Site 18 Beach House daily, seven days a week, May 29 - September 6, 2027 only (about 101 days); Site 19 Campground Shower Building daily May 1 - October 15 (about 168 days). Truth uses daily_7 as the stated weekly pattern. Model limitation: daily_7 is 360 days/yr in shared/types.ts, so their labor estimate runs high until a seasonal day count is supported.
Section 2.5 task-frequency table (Each service visit / Weekly / Monthly / Quarterly / Semi-annually / Annually) is per task, not a facility service level.

Floors: "Four-story office building (Lower Level and Floors 1-3)" = 4; Courthouse is "three stories over a full basement", so floors is left out of truth for Site 1; the Riverbend Trailhead Restroom states no story count, so floors is left out for Site 20.

Grounds are out of scope: building maintenance, grounds maintenance, lawn care and snow removal are by County staff (1.2, 2.7, 3.4). Acreage in sentences is information only: Courthouse square 2.3 acres, Lakeview County Park 46 acres with 14 acres of mowed turf and 900 feet of beach, 38-acre fairgrounds, 120-acre Cedar Bluff Park. Expected grounds is an empty list.

Distractor counts and years near the areas: restrooms (10, 14, 4, 16, 6, 18 + 10, 8, 3), 6 courtrooms, jury assembly seating 150, 212-bed jail, 12 exam rooms, 8 interview rooms, 64-site campground, years 1898 / 1987 / 1979 / 2008 / 2004, 2020 population 63,912. Restroom counts are not fixture counts, so restroomFixtures is not set.

Prior award appears only in Addendum Q&A A1: Northern Shores Building Services, Inc., Contract No. KC-23-0412, awarded November 2023, term February 1, 2024 - January 31, 2027, $91,240 monthly = $1,094,880 annually (event / rental cleaning billed separately). No total contract value is stated, so totalValue and periodMonths are not set. Other dollar amounts ($1,000,000 / $2,000,000 CGL, $1,000,000 auto, $50,000 crime bond, $150 / $250 deductions) are not award values.

Contract term: three years (February 1, 2027 - January 31, 2030) plus two one-year extensions = 5 contract years. Solicitation "RFP No. 2026-041". Climate: Michigan, with a November 1 - April 15 winter-conditions clause = cold.

DOCX specifics: the RFP header block and the addendum header are body paragraphs and a two-column key-dates table (no Word header/footer); site names in Sections 3.3-3.4 are bold runs, not heading styles; line breaks inside the Grand Traverse-style blocks are <w:br/> within one paragraph.
